fixed_shift_submissions_status_submitted.name: fixed_shift_submissions_status_submitted_at_chk
fixed_shift_submissions_status_submitted.value:
("fixed_shift_submissions"."status" = 'submitted' AND "fixed_shift_submissions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("fixed_shift_submissions"."status" = 'draft' AND "fixed_shift_submissions"."submitted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("fixed_shift_submissions"."status" = 'frozen')

shift_change_requests_kind_target.name: shift_change_requests_kind_target
shift_change_requests_kind_target.value: ("shift_change_requests"."kind" = 'regular' and "shift_change_requests"."training_period_id" is null) or ("shift_change_requests"."kind" = 'training' and "shift_change_requests"."training_period_id" is not null and "shift_change_requests"."regular_period_id" is null)

training_period_notes_test_range_chk.name: training_period_notes_test_range_chk
training_period_notes_test_range_chk.value:
("training_period_notes"."test_from" IS NULL AND "training_period_notes"."test_to" IS NULL)
        OR ("training_period_notes"."test_from" IS NOT NULL AND "training_period_notes"."test_to" IS NOT NULL AND "training_period_notes"."test_from" <= "training_period_notes"."test_to")

training_period_notes_summer_range_chk.name: training_period_notes_summer_range_chk
training_period_notes_summer_range_chk.value:
("training_period_notes"."summer_from" IS NULL AND "training_period_notes"."summer_to" IS NULL)
        OR ("training_period_notes"."summer_from" IS NOT NULL AND "training_period_notes"."summer_to" IS NOT NULL AND "training_period_notes"."summer_from" <= "training_period_notes"."summer_to")
